Type: sunset seascape canvas print
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, home office, above a sofa or bed
Style: coastal, contemporary, modern
Materials: gallery-wrapped canvas, brushed watercolor-like photographic print
Colors: soft pale blue, deep navy, warm orange, lavender, white
Shape: horizontal rectangle, frameless, low horizon with flying seagulls and reflections, medium-large, airy
Feel: serene, dreamy, calm, airy
Goes with: white or soft blue walls, light wood, linen, navy accents; coastal or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Seagulls Across the Sunset Horizon Canvas Print, 36" x 24"
product.description: After a long day, this tranquil print will help you relax. Birds sweep through a sunset horizon with all the blues, purples and oranges you remember from vacations with friends and family. This natural scene will blend with any existing style. A contemporary print of a classic, timeless scene Hand-stretched canvas on wood. Ready to hang with hardware included. 36" x 24" Made to order
